[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for vegan energy chews using dates.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients for Vegan Energy Chews:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 cup pitted dates  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup nut butter  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup rolled oats  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup chopped nuts (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Pinch of salt  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making vegan energy chews:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Soak dates in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Blend soaked dates until smooth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Combine date paste, nut
